newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 1996/97 mini vehicle sales up 0.2% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan 1996/97 mini vehicle sales up 0.2% yr/yr.

text.p: Japanese domestic sales of mini vehicles, with engines up to 660cc, rose 0.2 percent in 1996/97 from a year earlier to 1,729,990, the Japan Mini Vehicle Association (JMVA) said on Friday.
Of that total, minicar sales rose 4.5 percent to 974,566 while sales of mini commercial vehicles fell 4.9 percent to 755,424.
Domestic sales of major minicar makers were as follows (with percentage changes from a year earlier):
The 1996/97 sales figures included 3,638 mini vehicles made by smaller manufacturers.

Daihatsu's sharp rise resulted from strong demand for its Move multi-purpose vehicle, which was introduced in August 1995, a Daihatsu spokesman said. The new Daihatsu Midget II, a unique single-seat multi-purpose vehicle, launched in April 1996, also contributed to higher sales.
The JMVA did not give a forecast for mini vehicle sales in 1997/98 but the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association said in March it estimated mini vehicle sales in 1997/98 at 1.64 million units.
The JMVA said Japan's sales of motorcycles with engines of 126cc to 250cc fell 14.1 percent from a year earlier to 86,946 in 1996/97.
